pathwayCovered: Quebec investors, entrepreneurs and self-employed persons
relationToOtherQuebecFile: Bu, 'canada-quebec-selected-skilled-workers.json' dosyasindaki missingDataFlags'in bir kismini dolduruyor - ama SADECE bu is sinifi (investor/entrepreneur/self-employed) icin. Genel skilled-worker akisinin (QSWP/PSTQ, Arrima portali) kendi secim kriterleri hala ayri, hala belgelenmedi.

stage1_quebec.authority: Ministere de l'Immigration, de la Francisation et de l'Integration (MIFI)
stage1_quebec.note: Bu dosyada (onceki skilled-worker dosyasindan farkli olarak) Quebec'in kendi secim kriterleri DETAYLI olarak var - asagidaki subStreams alanina bakin.

fee.note: Skilled-worker akisinin $1,590 ucretinden YUKSEK - farkli ucret kademesi

stage2_federal.prerequisite: Must hold CSQ before applying for federal PR

ineligibleSectorsGeneral: Payday loans, cheque cashing, or pledge loans
Production, distribution, or sale of pornographic/sexually-explicit products or sex-industry services (nude/erotic dancing, escort services, erotic massage)

conditions.investmentAgreement: Must enter into an investment agreement with a financial intermediary that has signed a participation agreement with the Ministere AND with Investissement Quebec Immigrants Investisseurs Inc.

managementExperience.ineligibleSectors: Same as ineligibleSectorsGeneral, applies to where this experience was acquired

netWorth.exclusions: Donations received in the 6 months preceding application submission

education.minimum: Diploma equivalent to Quebec Secondary School Diploma (Diplome d'etudes secondaires), OR a 1+ year full-time program equivalent to Quebec Diploma of Vocational Studies / Certificate of Vocational Specialisation (secondary level) / Certificate of College Studies (college level)
education.ifObtainedInQuebec: Must be 600+ hours (secondary level) or 900+ hours (college level)

frenchLanguage.minimumLevel: Level 7 on the Echelle quebecoise des niveaux de competence en francais
acceptedTestProviders: Chambre de commerce et d'industrie de Paris Ile-de-France (CCIP-IDF)
acceptedSecondarySchoolDiplomasAsAlterna: French baccalaureate (general/vocational/technological) - French Ministry of Education
Certificat d'enseignement secondaire superieur (CESS) - Government of the French Community of Belgium
Certificat de maturite - French-speaking canton of Switzerland
frenchLanguage.interviewPossible: Ministere may call for an interview to verify declared French level

democraticValuesAttestation.exemption: Not required again if already obtained previously

investmentAndContribution.repaymentTerms: CAD $1,000,000 repaid without interest within 30 days of investment term end
incomeDestination: Fonds de developpement du marche du travail (FDMT)

noticeOfIntentToSelect.issuedWhen: Selection conditions met + Ministere confirms investment/contribution
noticeOfIntentToSelect.enables: Work permit application for applicant + included family members

quebecStayRequirement.proofSubmission: Documents demonstrating the stay must be mailed to the Ministere after the 12-month period is completed

subStreamsNamedOnly_notDetailedInSource.name: Innovative business
subStreamsNamedOnly_notDetailedInSource.description: Start up an innovative business or carry out an innovative project with support of an accompanying organization

subStreamsNamedOnly_notDetailedInSource.name: Business startup
subStreamsNamedOnly_notDetailedInSource.description: Start a business or operate a business already started

subStreamsNamedOnly_notDetailedInSource.name: Takeover
subStreamsNamedOnly_notDetailedInSource.description: Take over or operate an acquired business with assistance of a support organization

entrepreneur.note: Bu uc alt-akimin 'Show more' detaylari bu kaynakta acilmamis/kapsanmamis - ayri bir kaynaktan arastirilmasi gerekiyor.

conditions.practiceRequirement: Must practise profession in Quebec, alone or with paid/unpaid help
ineligibleSectors: Trading, leasing, brokerage, development or planning in the property/real-estate sector

regulatedProfessionRequirement.mustHave: EITHER authorization to practise in Quebec OR proof of partial/full training-diploma equivalence recognition (dated within 5 years of application)
processSteps: Find NOC code via Qualifications Quebec website (French only)
Check if profession is on the Liste des professions reglementees (Ministere's regulated professions list, PDF)
If regulated: find practice conditions via Qualifications Quebec site or the profession's Quebec regulatory body directly
Obtain authorization or recognition document from the relevant regulatory authority
regulatedProfessionRequirement.exemption: Not required if profession isn't regulated, OR if planning to practise in a context where authorization isn't required even if profession appears on the regulated list

netWorth.exclusions: Donations received in the 6 months preceding application submission

conditions.education: Same diploma requirement as investor sub-stream
conditions.frenchLanguage: Same Level 7 requirement, same accepted tests/providers as investor sub-stream

startUpDeposit.CMM_meaning: Communaute metropolitaine de Montreal (Montreal Metropolitan Community)
startUpDeposit.requestedWhen: A few weeks after file-opening confirmation letter, at the Ministere's request

financialSelfSufficiencyContract.startsFrom: date of obtaining permanent resident status
covers: dependent children who are Canadian citizens, if applicable
financialSelfSufficiencyContract.amountReference: Per Ministere's current schedules (not itemized in this source)

uploadOnly_noSignature.name: Declaration of Intent to Reside in Quebec - Economic Classes

conditionalForms_handSigned.name: Statutory Declaration of Common-law Union
conditionalForms_handSigned.condition: If common-law partner, plus 12+ months cohabitation proof

conditionalForms_handSigned.name: Separation Declaration for Minors Travelling to Canada
conditionalForms_handSigned.condition: If minor immigrating without both parents/guardians
conditionalForms_handSigned.note: Non-accompanying parent/guardian must sign in front of a notary public - stricter than the standard hand-signature requirement seen elsewhere

supportingDocuments: Travel documents/passport (regular passport only, NOT diplomatic/official/service/public-affairs) for applicant + spouse + dependent children
Visa copy if living outside passport-issuing country

Identity/civil status docs: birth certificates, name/DOB change documents, marriage/divorce/annulment certificates (all marriages if multiple), death certificate for former spouse if applicable, national ID/family registry
Police certificate per country lived in 6+ months since age 18 (valid ~1 year from issue)
Photo(s) for applicant + all family members, not older than 6 months
Certificat de selection du Quebec (CSQ) - issued by MIFI; remains valid for federal purposes until IRCC decision even if technically expired; MIFI stopped renewing CSQs as of 2018
federalApplicationStage.translationRule: Same as other Canada pathways: certified-translator-stamped translation + affidavit if no certified translator + scan of original; family members/applicant's own representative cannot translate.
federalApplicationStage.representativeRules: Same paid/unpaid representative framework as other Canada pathways (IMM 5476, cannot sign/log in on applicant's behalf, applicant must personally type name).

biometrics.note: Required even if previously given and valid

processingTimeFactors: criminal/security issues or background checks needed
unclear family situation (incomplete divorce/adoption, custody issues)

decisionOutcomes.approved: Must pay Right of Permanent Residence Fee if not already paid before finalization
decisionOutcomes.refused: Letter explaining reason; reconsideration requires new application + meeting eligibility + admissibility
decisionOutcomes.withdrawal: Possible via webform; partial fee refund depending on processing stage
